treatment.logline: A cash-van driver carries a private worry through rain-lit Colombo until a business instruction changes his route; a glance at his wrist keeps his reasons unreadable.

arc.beat: Work enclosed by the wet city and a personal keepsake
A live instruction interrupts the private space
The wrist glance precedes a deliberate turn

treatment.approach: Restrained handheld interior coverage, tight frames and dense rain-softened street backgrounds. Build a roughly 90-second reference assembly from sustained driving, listening and reactions, not extra events. Only Dinu is physically present. Recorded and live voices remain offscreen. Alternate spatially useful master and listener views where concern and instruction land, without implying a causal connection. The dashboard photograph is a static keepsake, never a living cutaway.

treatment.geography: All cameras stay inside the cash van on the passenger side of the driving axis. Dinu stays seated facing the windshield; dashboard and faded photograph lie ahead. Choose right-hand drive and the red thread on his left wrist, both hands normally on the wheel. A front oblique view, passenger-side profile and rear interior master preserve orientation. No other physical occupant is introduced.
treatment.key_image: His eyes lower toward the red thread while rain-lit road reflections continue beyond the wheel.
advice: Preserve L3 as a single uninterrupted recorded audio event and L5 as a single uninterrupted live-phone audio event; coverage is alternative or held listening material, not repeated messages.
Hold the photograph long enough to register a shared past but do not animate its figures or connect it to a new event.
Let the wrist glance precede the steering change; do not turn the thread into an explanation.
The bin supplies roughly 90 seconds of essential coverage because the scripted events alone occupy only 18 seconds; the assembly may breathe without adding business.

moments.what: L3 delivers the absence report and fear; Dinu absorbs it without an answer.
moments.cut_uses: Single C carries intact L3, profile reaction B holds its landing, and rear master A provides sustained listening context. These are one audio event's coverage, not repeated playback.

moments.what: The live connection interrupts the recorded-message space.
moments.cut_uses: Single C registers the incoming ring and the change in attention; no answering gesture is invented.

moments.what: L5 imposes the new destination while Dinu remains contained at the wheel.
moments.cut_uses: Single C carries intact L5; profile B and rear master A provide the held reception and its spatial context, without replaying the instruction.

moments.what: Dinu looks at the thread on his wrist, returns attention to the road and steers toward the industrial area.
moments.cut_uses: Single C makes the glance readable, low passenger two-plane view E reveals the wrist within the same gesture, and master A completes the turn toward industrial frontage. Use overlapping glance views only once in the assembly.

editor_notes: The 14 must takes total 90 seconds, including handles and overlapping coverage; this is raw material rather than a timed 90-second assembly. Shape the duration with the held driving and listening beats, not repeated story events.

Rear master A carries the cab geography and final turn; passenger profile B holds the message and instruction reactions; oblique single C carries the playback, live connection and gaze; low view E makes the wrist glance readable. Dashboard detail D is required by the script and remains a static faded print.

L3 and L5 are each laid in once, complete and uninterrupted, as offscreen audio. Render the silent listener sources without invented speech and add the recorded-message and live-phone treatments, incoming signal, rain, wipers and engine in post. No music is required.

Match the wrist glance across 2C-5 and 2E-1: both depict the same gesture, not two glances. Cut to 2A-4 only after the eyes return to the road; match both hands on the wheel and the thread on the left wrist. Match road direction, wiper phase and passing light across the cab angles.

Right-hand drive, the thread on the left wrist, and Dinu's plain charcoal work shirt are consistent staging choices where the packet does not specify those details. The dashboard photograph stays fixed; its pictured figures are not present as living characters.

Speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in and split screen are post-only options, not generated camera actions; no speed manipulation is needed for this scene. Clean held sources permit a discretionary digital punch-in.

Avoid mirrors and reflected faces, detailed finger work, physical contact, invented phone handling or a newly shown caller. Keep any photographic figures static, and do not imply that the personal message caused the route instruction.

editor_notes: The 14 must takes total 90 seconds, including handles and overlapping coverage; this is raw material rather than a timed 90-second assembly. Shape the duration with the held driving and listening beats, not repeated story events.

Rear master A carries the cab geography and final turn; passenger profile B holds the message and instruction reactions; oblique single C carries the playback, live connection and gaze; low view E makes the wrist glance readable. Dashboard detail D is required by the script and remains a static faded print.

L3 and L5 are each laid in once, complete and uninterrupted, as offscreen audio. Render the silent listener sources without invented speech and add the recorded-message and live-phone treatments, incoming signal, rain, wipers and engine in post. No music is required.

Match the wrist glance across 2C-5 and 2E-1: both depict the same gesture, not two glances. Cut to 2A-4 only after the eyes return to the road; match both hands on the wheel and the thread on the left wrist. Match road direction, wiper phase and passing light across the cab angles.

Right-hand drive, the thread on the left wrist, and Dinu's plain charcoal work shirt are consistent staging choices where the packet does not specify those details. The dashboard photograph stays fixed; its pictured figures are not present as living characters.

Speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in and split screen are post-only options, not generated camera actions; no speed manipulation is needed for this scene. Clean held sources permit a discretionary digital punch-in.

Avoid mirrors and reflected faces, detailed finger work, physical contact, invented phone handling or a newly shown caller. Keep any photographic figures static, and do not imply that the personal message caused the route instruction.
blend_notes: c15 — Cut into the single wrist glance in moment 7 from c12 or c13 and return without repeating the gesture; continue Dinu's cab and road audio from the anchor.
c16 — Lay the eye detail over part of the single continuous L3 event in moment 4; retain Aruni's recorded voice and cab audio from c05 without restarting playback.
c17 — Lay the steady right-hand detail over part of L5 in moment 6; retain Mudalali's phone voice and cab audio from c09, then return to the listener.
c18 — Cut in on the ring during c08 in moment 5 and return before L5; retain the incoming ring and Dinu's cab audio from c08.
c19 — Hold the forward industrial-road view after c14 completes the turn in moment 7; continue Dinu's engine and wet-road audio from c14, with no voice added.
c20 — Open moment 1 on wet windshield and road light before c01; lead in with Dinu's engine and rain audio matched to c01, with no voice added.

review.why: A brief interior rain-and-road focus shift introduces the isolation and the moving setting before the spatial master.
The locked dashboard photograph insert already gives the keepsake its essential physical detail; another view would repeat it.
The existing oblique single carries the playback onset cleanly, without inventing a device action or interrupting the developing attention.
A close eye detail offers a restrained held reaction beneath the recorded message, distinct from the existing profile and master.
A tight lower-face reaction marks the incoming ring without inventing a phone gesture.
A steady wheel-grip insert offers a physical counterpoint beneath the instruction while preserving the next moment's thread emphasis.
An isolated thread detail punctuates the single glance, and a forward view holds the changed direction without creating an arrival.
